_comment: Declared systems for the mini benchmark. One frozen configuration per system. Version fields marked RECORD_AT_RUNTIME are filled by the runner into predictions/<system>/run_status.json.

systems.model_revision: RECORD_AT_RUNTIME (Hugging Face commit sha or local clone git sha)
systems.output_granularity: segment-level (speaker_diarization; exclusive variant not used for scoring)

systems.display_name: NVIDIA NeMo MSDD (TitaNet-L embeddings, MarbleNet VAD)
systems.model_identifier: NeMo NeuralDiarizer with diar_msdd_telephonic + titanet_large + vad_multilingual_marblenet
systems.model_revision: RECORD_AT_RUNTIME (nemo_toolkit version; resolved YAML saved to results/configs/)
systems.package: nemo_toolkit[asr] (exact version RECORD_AT_RUNTIME; pinned container recommended)

settings.base_config: diar_infer_meeting.yaml from the pinned NeMo tag

systems.display_name: Commercial API (provider chosen at run time)
systems.model_identifier: RECORD_AT_RUNTIME (e.g. deepgram nova-3 + diarize_model=v2; assemblyai speaker_labels; pyannoteai precision-3)
systems.model_revision: RECORD_AT_RUNTIME from response metadata (e.g. Deepgram diarize_info.model_uuid)
systems.overlap_capable: provider-dependent (word-level STT labels cannot express overlap)

settings.language_hint: en (same for every STT-based API; not a speaker-count hint)
